name: genpark-agent-execution-tree-rollback-checkpointer-skill
description: Autonomous Agent Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) State Rollback Checkpointer. Allows long-running personal agents (Manus, Devin) to snapshot environment/context states, evaluate branch viability, and backtrack when an exploration path fails without restarting from scratch.

tools.name: manage_execution_tree
tools.description: Manage agent execution tree checkpoints, state rollbacks, branch viability evaluations, and dead-end pruning.

action.description: The action to perform on the agent execution tree.

node_id.description: The identifier of the node/checkpoint for rollback or branch evaluation.

parent_id.description: Parent checkpoint ID when creating a new snapshot branch.

state_payload.description: State dictionary to checkpoint (variables, memory, plan steps, scratchpad).

branch_metrics.description: Heuristic metrics (errors_encountered, goal_distance, confidence_score) for branch evaluation.
